boundary_decision.rationale: An official statistical product is a governed aggregate with stable identity across concepts, structures, sources, methods, observations, vintages, quality evidence, release events and disclosure decisions, so aggregate is more defensible than entity or dataset.

decisions.rationale: Official status records authority, mandate and governance. A value still requires concept, population, period, unit, dimensions, source, method, quality, uncertainty, vintage and status.

decisions.concept: Product, series, observation, vintage and release identities
decisions.rationale: These records change at different rates and serve different references, so none may be collapsed into a title, file, chart or current numeric value.
Official Statistics owns semantic product and observation meaning while Dataset and Data Register owns packaged collections and distributions.
The product records source bindings and statistical transformations, but respondent identity and operational administrative or transactional records stay in their owning systems.
Reference, collection, processing, effective, release and ingestion times express different facts and cannot substitute for one another.

decisions.concept: Provisional, estimated, adjusted, revised, corrected and final
decisions.rationale: Every published state is an immutable vintage with predecessor, reason, authority and release time; revision never silently overwrites history.
Accuracy, uncertainty, comparability and fitness claims require an assessor, method, evidence, scope, time and limitations rather than inheriting from official status.

decisions.disposition: accepted as controlled references and projections
decisions.rationale: Respondent-level data remain external and any microdata or small-cell projection requires direct and indirect identification assessment, authorization and disclosure controls.
Tables, APIs, charts and publications are digest-pinned projections of a product vintage and must declare filters, rounding, transformations and information loss.
The standards provide complementary structure, metadata and lifecycle semantics, but their serializations or process stages do not determine Vercy logical identity.
Official Statistics is an informational aggregate. Numerical observations are method-bound claims about populations or phenomena, not intrinsic physical properties of this record.
Every finding asks about governed value and scope, authority and method, quality and uncertainty, validation, confidentiality, revision and history. Domain specialists still need to refine profiles.
